plain_text: The National Institute on Aging has helpful tips and resources
semantic_text: The National Institute on Aging has helpful tips and resources

plain_text:
When older adults and people with terminal illnesses
are dying, they may need a lot of care. This care can
last from days to months, and it will look different
for everyone depending on their needs.
semantic_text: When older adults and people with terminal illnesses are dying, they may need a lot of care. This care can last from days to months, and it will look different for everyone depending on their needs.

plain_text:
End-of-life care can be medical and physical, but it can
also look like emotional or spiritual support. It often involves
making treatment or legal decisions with or on behalf of the
dying person. Family and friends of the person who is dying
may need support, too.
semantic_text: End-of-life care can be medical and physical, but it can also look like emotional or spiritual support. It often involves making treatment or legal decisions with or on behalf of the dying person. Family and friends of the person who is dying may need support, too.

plain_text:
This can be a lot to manage. The National Institute on Aging
(NIA) has information to help you plan end-of-life care for
yourself or a loved one.
semantic_text:
This can be a lot to manage. The National Institute on Aging
(NIA) has information to help you plan end-of-life care for yourself or a loved one.

plain_text:
End-of-life care may involve a team of doctors, nurses, palliative
or hospice staff, counselors, and religious community members.
People who are dying generally need care in several areas:
semantic_text: End-of-life care may involve a team of doctors, nurses, palliative or hospice staff, counselors, and religious community members. People who are dying generally need care in several areas:

plain_text:
■ Physical comfort. The person may experience pain,
breathing problems, skin irritation, digestive issues,
fatigue, or temperature sensitivities. These symptoms can
be hard to manage, so ask their health care provider how
best to relieve them.
■ Mental and emotional needs. Be present with the
person. Try to set a comforting mood by playing music,
reading, or holding hands if they wish. A counselor with
experience in end-of-life emotional issues can give
you advice.
■ Spiritual needs. Many people find solace in their faith
at the end of life, while others may struggle with spiritual
beliefs. Talking, praying together, or listening to religious
music can help.
■ Practical tasks. Both the dying person and their
caregivers may need help with practical tasks to ensure
peace of mind for everyone. This might include big things
like personal affairs or small things such as laundry.
semantic_text: ■ Physical comfort. The person may experience pain, breathing problems, skin irritation, digestive issues, fatigue, or temperature sensitivities. This might include big things like personal affairs or small things such as laundry.

plain_text:
End-of-life care can happen anywhere, but common settings are
at home, in a hospital, or in a care facility. Each of these options
comes with unique costs and equipment needs depending on
the type of care.
semantic_text: End-of-life care can happen anywhere, but common settings are at home, in a hospital, or in a care facility. Each of these options comes with unique costs and equipment needs depending on the type of care.

plain_text:
Not everyone has the chance to decide where they will die,
but people who know the end of their life is approaching may
be able to prepare. An advance care plan can help loved ones
and the patient's doctor know what care they want at the end
of their life.
semantic_text: Not everyone has the chance to decide where they will die, but people who know the end of their life is approaching may be able to prepare. An advance care plan can help loved ones and the patient's doctor know what care they want at the end of their life.

plain_text:
Making health care decisions for yourself or someone who is no longer
able to do so can be overwhelming. That's why it's important to get a
clear idea about preferences and arrangements while you can make
decisions and participate in legal and financial planning together.
semantic_text: Making health care decisions for yourself or someone who is no longer able to do so can be overwhelming. That's why it's important to get a clear idea about preferences and arrangements while you can make decisions and participate in legal and financial planning together.

plain_text:
Use this checklist to ensure health care and
financial arrangements are in place before
serious illness or a health care crisis.
semantic_text: Use this checklist to ensure health care and financial arrangements are in place before serious illness or a health care crisis.

plain_text:
Start discussions early with
your loved one while everyone
can still help make decisions.
semantic_text: Start discussions early with your loved one while everyone can still help make decisions.

plain_text:
Create documents that communicate
health care, financial management,
and end of life wishes for yourself
and the people you care for, with legal
advice as needed.
semantic_text: Create documents that communicate health care, financial management, and end of life wishes for yourself and the people you care for, with legal advice as needed.

plain_text:
✓ Review plans regularly, and update documents as
circumstances change.
semantic_text: ✓ Review plans regularly, and update documents as circumstances change.

plain_text:
Put important papers in one
place. Make sure a trusted family
member or friend knows the
location and any instructions.
semantic_text: Put important papers in one place. Make sure a trusted family member or friend knows the location and any instructions.

plain_text:
Make copies of health care
directives to be placed in all medical
files, including information on every
doctor seen.
semantic_text: Make copies of health care directives to be placed in all medical files, including information on every doctor seen.

plain_text:
Give permission in advance for
a doctor or lawyer to talk directly
with a caregiver as needed.
semantic_text: Give permission in advance for a doctor or lawyer to talk directly with a caregiver as needed.

plain_text:
Reduce anxiety about funeral
and burial arrangements by
planning ahead.
semantic_text: Reduce anxiety about funeral and burial arrangements by planning ahead.
